title: サトノダイヤモンド登場！

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A diamond, with unbreakable strength and a precious luster impossible to tarnish.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A jewel of countless hopes and expectations. That is who I am—Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mother. Father. Please don't look at me with such sad expressions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I made it into my top choice school, Tracen Academy, didn't I? You should be seeing me off with smiles on your faces! ♪

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right! Take care of yourself and don't push yourself too hard, dear.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: We're behind you every step of the way, cheering for you to achieve your dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My only dream is to fulfill the Satono family's wish…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (To produce an illustrious racer capable of winning G1 races—that is the Satono family's ultimate goal and the reason I was born.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My family rejoiced at my birth and placed their hopes upon my success. I'm determined to fulfill their wish.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's right. I swear to make a name for myself and leave a grand impression in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I, Dia, will make my family's dream a reality!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Finally… Finally! The time has come!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond and I set out on her quest to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The date of her debut race is set, so I hurry out to the track to share the news. But when I get there…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It seems you'll be making your debut in the Twinkle Series this year. How are you feeling about that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm extremely excited for the opportunity. I can't tell you how long I've been waiting for this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find Satono Diamond being interviewed by a large crowd of reporters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Have your parents or the Satono Group commented in regards to your upcoming debut?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Everyone has been very supportive and told me to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts on a potential first-ever G1 victory for the Satono Group? I'm sure everyone has great expectations of you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They do. Naturally, we are all hoping I can triumph in a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Then again, every Umamusume aims for victory. I'll work hard so as not to lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Satono is handling the situation so well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then again, she is no stranger to the spotlight. Now that it's been decided that she will debut, it's no surprise people are rushing to interview her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Mejiro McQueen, one of the Umamusume representing the prestigious Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She's been interviewed countless times before, so I'm sure she can handle herself just fine. What about you, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, you'll be expected to comment on various matters as well. You should be prepared for when that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing those words makes me feel a little dizzy. I'm once again reminded of how incredible my trainee actually is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I first met her, Satono Diamond struck me as someone far removed from the rest of us regular folk. And yet, she chose me to be her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Apologies for keeping you waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've finished all my interviews!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Why, McQueen, you're here too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. Congratulations on your upcoming debut.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh… Thank you very much! I'm honored to receive congratulations from you. Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Just as you represent the Mejiro family, I, too, shall do my family proud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing your success. Well then, if you'll excuse me, I must be going.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wonder if McQueen stopped by just to congratulate me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sigh… She's so kind and thoughtful! I'm always left in awe of her effortless grace!
choice_data_list: She seems to expect great things from you.
She seems to expect great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear Satono Diamond idolizes Mejiro McQueen, so she must be elated to have been congratulated by her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't disappoint McQueen with any subpar performances! Let's get straight to training!
choice_data_list: Before that, would you like to know the date of your debut?
Before that, would you like to know the date of your debut?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's been decided?! When? When is it?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… How did I do on that lap?
choice_data_list: You need to pick up the pace a little in the first half.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I'm holding back too much… Let me try one more lap!
Wow! Look at you go, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You seem super motivated today for some reason. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The date of my debut race has been decided!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm finally at the starting line!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Yaaay! That's great, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is overjoyed. Apparently, when they were young, these two made a promise to run together in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Last year, before I even became Satono Diamond's trainer, Kitasan Black made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Satono Diamond was not showing any signs of being race-ready at the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume is considered race-ready when she enters a phase where her running ability dramatically improves. Before then, she isn't expected to perform well even if she manages to debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond chose to hold off on her debut until she was properly race-ready, rather than rushing to debut alongside Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Satono Diamond became race-ready at last, she teamed up with me. That brings us to the present.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can finally… finally chase after you now! My days of watching from the sidelines as you run farther and farther away are finished!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll be on your heels in no time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm not going to let you catch me easily! I'll be sprinting at full throttle too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll still catch up with you. I'll catch you, and the two of us will run in the Twinkle Series together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm holding you to that! But watch out—I'm gonna leave you behind if you're too slow!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You won't have to worry about that. Isn't that right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yep! I'll make sure that doesn't happen!
Yep! I'll make sure that doesn't happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond—the budding star of the Satono family—shoulders innumerable hopes and dreams. And now, my days of making her shine brighter than anyone have begun in earnest.
